judged_text: addMembers and removeMember chain only .then() with no rejection handler, so a 422 from can_not_modify_automatic (or any validation failure on group.save) leaves the UI in its prior state with no client-side indication of failure. Admins clicking 'Add' or the remove 'x' on a group the server refuses get a silent no-op (beyond whatever global ajax error flash Discourse shows); combined with the always-rendered remove control on automatic groups, this produces clicks that appear to do nothing.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, both `addMembers` and `removeMember` return `Discourse.ajax(...).then(function() { self.findMembers(); })` with no local rejection handling, and the controller actions (`admin-group.js.es6`) call these methods without `catch`/error UI updates. If the server responds with 422 (e.g., `can_not_modify_automatic` or `group.save` errors in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`/`#remove_member`), the member list won’t be reloaded and there’s no explicit client-side feedback in this code. However, the finding’s claim that the remove control is “always-rendered on automatic groups” is contradicted by `group_member.hbs` and `group.hbs`, which both gate add/remove UI behind `{{#unless automatic}}`.
